stemMd: Why did the students keep the bob mass unchanged in Experiment1?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To show that all masses necessarily give identical results.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To make string length a dependent variable.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To compare lengths without simultaneously changing mass

explanationMd: Holding mass constant controls a possible alternative influence while length is varied. Experiment2 separately addresses mass.

distractorRationale.a: Holding one mass fixed does not test other masses.
distractorRationale.b: Length remained the deliberately changed variable.
